reason: Route prediction only lets the browser's client router skip the route-tree prefetch for URLs that match already-learned route patterns (it deopts for rewrites and intercepted routes and renders the same result), so it is a prefetch optimization no application code or config written for Next 15 (which had no such option) depends on.

The TypeScript >= 7 rejection exists only on the 15.5 backport line; the pinned next 16.4.2 accepts TypeScript 7 (verify-typescript-setup only warns below 5.1.0, and the template runs it with TypeScript 7.0.2).
